name: Xiao Lu
source:
Personification of Minced pork rice.

Personality: Lassitude; physical strength so weak she gets breathless just to walk. Looks down too much at herself, that she misunderstood that people around her are making fun of her.
Likes: Slothful life, games, people who taking care of her
Dislikes: Do something seriously
